# Badminton icon

The racket and shuttlecock artwork is from Pinhead v15.16.0, released under CC0 1.0.

- Source SVG. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waysidemapping/pinhead/v15.16.0/icons/hand_tools/badminton_racket_and_shuttlecock.svg
- License. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waysidemapping/pinhead/v15.16.0/LICENSE

`badminton.svg` preserves the source. `web/icons.mjs` embeds the same paths with `fill="currentColor"` and a CSS class for sizing.
